title: Usable explanations
mechanism: A person cannot effectively identify and challenge a consequential factual or rule-application error when the grounds, sources, or correction route are inaccessible. This is a research hypothesis, not a finding that every unexplained decision is wrong.
intervention: Offer plain-language, source-linked explanations and accessible readback or translation assistance above legally required notice; preserve an equivalent non-digital route.
outcome: Independently verified operative correction within 30 calendar days of the prespecified time zero among cases meeting independently defined correctable-error eligibility. Prespecify missing verification handling and report completeness separately.
null_hypothesis: H0: the intention-to-treat risk difference in verified correction by day 30 is zero.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: the intention-to-treat risk difference in verified correction by day 30 differs from zero (two-sided).
unit: Randomized eligible person or case; family-linked records analyzed together.
design: Prospective randomized offer of additional explanation assistance; standard legally compliant notice remains in every arm. Fix error eligibility independently before assignment, primary outcome, time zero, sample size, stopping rule, and adjudication protocol before evaluation.
legislative_clause: Proposed section 2(b): require understandable grounds, lawful source access, review route, and correspondence between human-readable and machine-readable notices; section 4 sets proposed maximum response periods.
guardrails: Do not withhold existing notice, accommodations, representation, or review rights.
No personal records enter the public research repository.
A useful explanation is not itself proof of truth or completed correction.
Do not treat a subject's agreement during readback as a waiver or condition of service.

title: Source provenance and false corroboration
mechanism: Several reports may repeat one original assertion and be mistaken for independent confirmation. The selected historical evidence motivates a test; it does not estimate this mechanism's population prevalence.
intervention: Display origin identifiers, transformation history, contradictions, and common-source links; require an independent-source check before counting corroboration.
outcome: False independent-corroboration judgments per eligible fixed-ground-truth task, with task difficulty and reference adjudication documented.
null_hypothesis: H0: the intention-to-treat risk difference in false-corroboration error per task is zero.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: the intention-to-treat risk difference in false-corroboration error per task differs from zero (two-sided).
unit: Randomized reviewer; repeated tasks nested within reviewer.
design: Start with randomized simulation using synthetic cases and predefined provenance truth. Balance task order and difficulty, account for within-reviewer dependence, and reserve independent evaluation tasks. Field effectiveness requires a separate study.
legislative_clause: Proposed section 2(a): retain a versioned source and transformation manifest; identify common-origin reports. Section 3(a): test common-source repetition before deployment.
guardrails: No synthetic error is inserted into a live consequential decision.
Source count is not source quality; do not suppress genuinely independent contrary evidence.
A checksum or digest does not verify the truth of an originating statement.
Simulation results cannot be represented as demonstrated field harm reduction.

title: Review capacity and authority to correct
mechanism: A detected error may remain operative when review capacity is saturated or the reviewer lacks a lawful path to alter the decision. This is a proposed operational mechanism, not a causal conclusion from case counts.
intervention: Provide additional reviewer time, source access, and a clearly assigned official with lawful authority to correct or route the decision to the official or court that can act.
outcome: Independently verified correction within a prespecified deadline; secondary measures include latency, error recurrence, accessibility, quality, and cost.
null_hypothesis: H0: the intention-to-treat risk difference in timely verified correction is zero.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: the intention-to-treat risk difference in timely verified correction differs from zero (two-sided).
unit: Randomized office; eligible cases nested within offices, with family links retained.
design: Cluster-randomized additional capacity where lawful and feasible. Define the eligible cohort with independent ascertainment to avoid treatment-dependent error detection changing the denominator. Measure arrival rate, capacity, complexity, spillovers, and implementation fidelity; use design-aware intervals and power calculations.
legislative_clause: Proposed section 3(b): assign adequate reviewer resources and lawful correction authority; section 4(a): require escalation of unresolved delays without resetting the original clock.
guardrails: No arm receives less than legally required capacity or review protections.
An agency official may not disregard or override a court order.
Lower average delay cannot compensate for more erroneous outcomes.
Capacity formulas are approximations and do not certify mission capability or safety.

title: Verified correction propagation
mechanism: An approved correction may not reach every operative endpoint; superseded information may continue to trigger an adverse action. The historical atlas often lacks the follow-up needed to determine whether this occurred.
intervention: Inventory relevant endpoints; send a versioned correction; obtain delivery receipts; independently verify operative state and monitor recurrence.
outcome: Repeat adverse action based on the superseded information within 90 days after baseline correction among independently defined eligible corrected cases, with loss to follow-up reported.
null_hypothesis: H0: the intention-to-treat risk difference in 90-day superseded-data recurrence is zero.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: the intention-to-treat risk difference in 90-day superseded-data recurrence differs from zero (two-sided).
unit: Randomized office or connected network; corrected cases nested within cluster.
design: Randomize additional endpoint verification for an independently defined baseline-corrected cohort. Specify endpoint inventory, operative-state evidence, time zero, spillover handling, competing outcomes, and follow-up before testing. Use cluster-aware analysis and retain unresolved endpoints explicitly.
legislative_clause: Proposed section 4(b)-(c): distinguish receipt from verified operative correction, assign responsibility for unresolved endpoints, and report 90-day recurrence.
guardrails: Preserve every existing correction and notification duty in all arms.
Unknown endpoint inventory is not complete coverage.
Do not erase lawful historical evidence; preserve superseded versions with access control and current-status labels.
Share corrections only with recipients entitled to receive them; publish aggregate research results.
A correction dependent on a court order requires authorized judicial action.
